files.title: File:McKenzie-Kabic Block, Main Street, Bowling Green, OH - 52099686243.jpg
files.author: w_lemay
files.caption: Built in 1892, this Richardsonian Romanesque Revival-style building features a rusticated stone facade with a decorative ballustrade at the top, blind arches over the window openings, an arched attic window, contemporary ground level storefronts, and replacement windows.  The building is a contributing structure in the Main Street Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1980.
